title: Sunday · the bed, with the dog in it
logline: The dog bed under the drafting table, in watercolor, with the dog in it, fourteen, asleep. The composition of 'The Empty Chair' a year early, with everything in it. The strip doesn't know; the book does.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the drafting table's underside and the braided bed beneath it, the old dog asleep in it, the lamp's light from above.

image.prompt: an old dog asleep in a braided bed beneath a drafting table in a lamp's warm light, wet-on-wet watercolor, no words
image.notes: 'The Empty Chair' (dw_2014-11-30), tier 1, with the dog in it. Draw it exactly.

panels.name: Bed

panels.composition: Tier 2: the gray muzzle on the bed's edge, close. The breath. Held.

image.prompt: an old dog's gray muzzle resting on the edge of a braided bed, close, no words

panels.name: Muzzle

panels.composition: Tier 3: the lamp on. Just on. The table. The bed below, the dog in it. Held.

image.prompt: a drafting table with its lamp on and an old dog asleep in a bed beneath, no words
image.notes: Tier 3 is the lamp on. In 2014 it goes off.

panels.name: Lamp

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The Empty Chair, a year early, full.
